auth_note: Catalog API key must be requested by email to NARA; the x-api-key header is used. The anonymous probe returned an HTML page, not API data.
rate_limit: 10,000 queries per month per API key by default; key blocked until the first of the next month when exceeded; higher limit on request.
data_license: Public domain (US federal government work), with rare exceptions
bulk_access: API can facilitate bulk downloads of records (no separate dump URL documented in captured text)
probe_observation: The probe returned HTTP 200 with a 5454-byte text/html page (Swagger/SPA shell) that rendered to empty text, so no JSON search result was captured.

evidence.quote: To request a Catalog API key, please send an email to Catalog_API@nara.gov with your name and the email address you would like associated with your key.
NARA limits the number of Catalog API requests to a default rate of 10,000 queries per month per API key.
NARA's archival metadata is all assumed to be in the public domain, as a work of the federal government, with only rare exceptions
The API may also be used to facilitate bulk downloads of records from the National Archives Catalog.
If your research or development efforts require a higher limit, please contact Catalog_API@nara.gov with your use case/research need and justification.

not_established: Cost/pricing is not stated in captured text. Whether key approval is automatic or discretionary is not stated (key-approval chosen because issuance is by email request to engineers). docs.txt and probe.txt are empty JS shells; the OpenAPI JSON route (extra-api) also rendered to 10 bytes. No live API response captured; key-less behaviour of the probe is not shown.
